title: Beta Release "Pidato Pertanggungjawaban"
notes:
Expect some bugs and missing features, but the game is playable and the core mechanics are in place.
This is a beta release, so please report any bugs you find!

ROADMAP (in order of priority):
  • Indonesian translation, alongside reworked localization.
  • 1999 Presidential Election right after the Accountability Speech (Three-way, Four-way, or Five-way election)
  • Dynamic Epilogues based on player choices.
  • Compressing image and music files so they don't consume too much storage.
  • Polishing the gameplay experience.
  • Adding more themes and customisation
  • Modding support.
  • Adding more achievements
  • (NOT FINAL) Add a Foreign Affairs interaction
  • (NOT FINAL) Rework the gameplay to be more dynamic
